Promotes thicker, stronger hair growth as it reduces shedding

Improves widening parts, thinning, and receding hairlines

How To Use
1

Apply 0.5-1 dropperful once nightly, or as directed by your Musely doctor.

Gently press the dropper and apply the solution directly to the crown of the scalp, or put it in your hands and massage it into the areas you're treating.

3

Wash your hands to remove any remaining medication.

4

Do not get your hair wet for at least 4 hours.

Apply only to the scalp. If applied elsewhere, it may stimulate new hair growth. Avoid areas around the hair, such as the neck and face.
